notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
+short returns bare answer value only — just the IP address or record content, no headers, footers, or metadata. Ideal for scripting where output is piped directly into other commands.

=== SCRIPTING USE ===
IP=$(dig +short A target.com) → use $IP directly in subsequent commands.
for sub in $(cat subdomains.txt); do dig +short A ${sub}.target.com; done → mass resolution.

=== vs +noall +answer ===
+short: absolutely minimal (just the value). +noall +answer: preserves TTL and record type. Use +short when only the IP/value matters.
